---
title: "Untitled"
format: html
editor: visual
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
dane <- read_lines("dane.txt")
```

```{r}
start <- str_locate(dane[1], 'S')[1,1] %>% c()
dane <- dane[-1]
```

```{r}
# Rozwiązanie pierwszej części
ile <- 0
ns <- c(start)

for (line in dane) {
  newns <- NULL
  for (n in ns) {
    if(str_split_i(line,"",n) == "^"){
      newns <- c(newns, n-1, n+1)
      ile <- ile + 1 
    }
    else
      newns <- c(newns,n)
  }
  ns <- newns %>% unique()
}

ile
```

```{r}
#Rozwiązanie drugiej części
worlds <- tibble(n = start,k = 1)

for (line in dane) {
  worlds <- worlds %>% 
  rowwise() %>% 
  mutate(newworlds = if_else(str_split_i(line,"",n) == "^",
                             tibble(n = c(n-1,n+1),k) %>% list(),
                             tibble(n,k) %>% list()))

worlds <- worlds$newworlds %>%
  bind_rows() %>% 
  group_by(n) %>% 
  summarise(k = sum(k))
}

worlds %>% 
  summarise(ile = sum(k) %>% as.character())


```
